rng: NumPy PCG64, base seed plus per-layer offsets
originality: Original offline FFT noise and low-Q irregular modal synthesis; no sampled recordings, VO, speech, music or external licensed assets.

contract.early_hit_cast_crossrelease_curve: linear, naturally ends at .32s if sooner

preview.timing_scope: Accepted r9 proxy callbacks; never production trigger constants

cast.wav.true_peak_method: scipy.signal.resample_poly 8/1, default Kaiser beta5 FIR, constant boundary
cast.wav.prospective_timbre: Soft but immediate opening brush; outward warm air with a short irregular water/glass glint, no chord or sustained ring.

mastering.method: Stereo-linked smooth lookaround peak-envelope gain, sixth-order soft knee; RMS solve
mastering.quantization: Round nearest PCM16, no dither; exact silence retained

hit.wav.true_peak_method: scipy.signal.resample_poly 8/1, default Kaiser beta5 FIR, constant boundary
hit.wav.prospective_timbre: One warm water-light slap with a clear rounded centre; lower-level airy illumination trails into silence. No storm crack.

mastering.method: Stereo-linked smooth lookaround peak-envelope gain, sixth-order soft knee; RMS solve
mastering.quantization: Round nearest PCM16, no dither; exact silence retained

preview_mix.wav.true_peak_method: scipy.signal.resample_poly 8/1, default Kaiser beta5 FIR, constant boundary

acceptance.limitations: Independent game/native-DSP lifecycle acceptance is owned by the main thread. Numeric gates do not establish timbre, absence of perceived harshness/ringing or actual game mix audibility.
